items.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Pushes Deeper Into Latin American AI Megaprojects
items.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL) is expanding its role in large AI infrastructure projects across Latin America, backed by an AI server backlog. The company is being identified as a key participant in the multibillion dollar global All in One Infrastructure market. Management is using Latin American AI megaprojects to extend Dell’s reach beyond its traditional North American infrastructure base.
